ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels to 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white central field with low-intensity dark margins. Distinct parallel dark linear streaks on the distal left lobe. Randomly distributed low-intensity focal spots (1-3 pixel diameter) across the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central indentation with a measured interior pixel angle of approximately 58 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations along the trailing edge; serrations are most pronounced on the distal thirds of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge towards the tips; leading edge is partially occluded by water spray.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small dark-pixel clusters distributed on the white ventral surface. Heavy, irregular high-contrast clusters concentrated at the fluke tips indicating barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Five distinct, parallel, dark-pixel linear marks (rake scars) on the outer edge of the left lobe, oriented diagonally toward the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel rake scars on the left lobe trailing edge; significant barnacle encrustation on the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Major pixel occlusion at the peduncle junction due to white-water splash.
